column1: # Commits that must never reach a remote. <full-sha>\t<reason>.
# Enforced by .git/hooks/pre-push, which is NOT tracked: a fresh clone has no
# such hook, so this file alone protects nobody. Re-install the hook when you
# re-clone. A quarantined commit is not deleted —
# it stays reachable locally so old references still resolve — it is
# refused at the only boundary where it would do harm.
# To clear a branch: rebase or cherry-pick ITS OWN commits onto a parent
# that excludes the quarantined one, then re-check with

column2: Pre-neutralisation fixtures commit (2026-07-30). Its seven captured TUI panes carried an operator account address, the organisation name derived from it, a subscription tier and a session path. Superseded on main by the amended, neutralised 3f61802 — but it stays reachable from every branch cut before the amendment, and an ordinary merge would carry it back into public history. Rebase such a branch onto 3f61802 before harvesting it.
